author: Durk
install_msg: Thanks for installing DeadlockTracker! Use `[p]help DeadlockTracker` to get started. Set a feed channel with `[p]deadlockset channel #channel`, add players with `[p]deadlockset addplayer <steamid/name/url> [@member]`, then enable with `[p]deadlockset toggle on`.
name: DeadlockTracker
short: Track Deadlock players: look up stats and auto-post their match results to a channel.
description: A Redbot cog using the deadlock-api.com API. Look up a player's stats (rank, recent win-rate, top heroes, recent matches) and maintain a per-server watchlist of players whose finished matches are automatically posted to a feed channel, with optional Discord member links so posts can ping them.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Deadlock account IDs added to the per-server watchlist, an optional Discord user ID linking a watched player to a Discord member, a per-player display label, and the last processed match ID used to detect new matches. It does not store message content.
